sources.title: Structured Hello interview source containing the longest-palindrome space-optimization prompt
Deterministic and randomized longest-palindrome brute-force differential validation

claims.text: The preserved source asks for the longest palindromic substring with space-complexity optimization, without specifying language, null/empty behavior, tie-breaking, or Unicode comparison units.
The candidate makes Java UTF-16 char semantics, null rejection, empty-string handling, and earliest-start tie-breaking explicit implementation contracts instead of attributing them to the source.
The center-expansion implementation matches an independent brute-force palindrome oracle on 12 deterministic cases and 10000 seeded randomized strings, including odd/even centers and tie cases.
The candidate keeps only constant-size search state and explicitly separates auxiliary O(1) space from the returned output string while retaining worst-case O(n^2) time.
